stage_range.title: Stages to run
stage_range.description: The pipeline is one process. Pick where to start and where to stop; everything between runs in order, with the malignant and non-malignant arms fanning out after stratification.

from.title: Start at
from.description: align needs FASTQs and a ~15 GB cellranger reference. Starting anywhere after qc requires the matching input object below.

to.title: Stop after
to.description: 'end' runs through to the integration layer and the master report.

project_name.title: Project name
project_name.description: Prefixes every output object and report, e.g. <project>_qc_dbl_singlet_object.RDS.

entry_point.title: Entry point object
entry_point.description: Only needed when starting after QC. Which one depends on where you start: cluster/annotation/cnv/stratify take the pre-split object; metaprog takes the malignant compartment; batchcorrect/trajectory/cellcomm/tme take the non-malignant one. Leave blank when starting from align or qc.

input_seurat_object.title: Seurat object (pre-split)
input_seurat_object.description: s3:// path to an .RDS from a previous run, e.g. <outdir>/<project>/annotation/data/*_annotated_object.RDS

input_tumor_object.title: Malignant compartment
input_tumor_object.description: s3:// path, for --from metaprog. Written by stratify as *_malignant_object.RDS

input_nonmalignant_object.title: Non-malignant compartment
input_nonmalignant_object.description: s3:// path, for --from batchcorrect / trajectory / cellcomm / tme. Written by stratify as *_nonmalignant_object.RDS

input_bam_path.title: Aligned BAM glob (optional)
input_bam_path.description: s3:// glob of possorted_genome_bam.bam. Numbat phases reads at heterozygous SNPs and cannot run without it; leave blank and Numbat self-disables with a warning.

input_vdj_contigs.title: VDJ contigs glob (optional)
input_vdj_contigs.description: s3:// glob of filtered_contig_annotations.csv. Required for the TCR stage when not starting from align.

modality.title: Modality
modality.description: GEX+TCR also runs cellranger vdj and enables the TCR stage.

input_reference_object.title: Azimuth reference object (optional)
input_reference_object.description: s3:// path to a reference .RDS. Without it Azimuth is skipped and annotation falls back to scType.

alignment_mode.title: Alignment mode
alignment_mode.description: Only used when starting at align. standard = one row per sample; multi = hashtag-multiplexed, demultiplexed by cellranger multi; demux = pooled FASTQs, barcodes detected from the I1 index.

tumor_type.title: Tumour type
tumor_type.description: Sets the scType marker database, the lineages that skip the state-level pass, the tumour-lineage label and the normal reference lineages together, so they always describe the same tumour. Any of those filled in below overrides its preset.

annot_db.title: scType marker database (override)
annot_db.description: s3:// path to your own marker CSV (parent_level,cell_group,cell_annotation,markers). Leave blank to use the database for the tumour type above.

annot_primary.title: Primary annotator
annot_primary.description: Whose labels the CNV, stratification and communication stages read. Both annotators still run and both are reported. Azimuth contributes nothing unless a reference object is supplied.

annot_state_exclude.title: Skip state-level annotation for (override)
annot_state_exclude.description: Semicolon-separated major classes that get no second, state-level pass. Leave blank to use the list for the tumour type above; only set it with your own marker database.

ambient_rna.title: Ambient RNA (CellBender)
ambient_rna.description: Reads the RAW matrix and estimates the background from empty droplets. Expected cells and total droplets are derived PER SAMPLE from each library's own UMI curve, so they are deliberately not exposed here.

skip_cellbender.title: Skip ambient RNA removal
skip_cellbender.description: On this cohort it cut the share of non-plasma cells carrying any immunoglobulin from 22.5% to 12.3%, and raised inferCNV/Numbat agreement from 92.2% to 95.5%.

cellbender_cuda.title: Use GPU
cellbender_cuda.description: Enable on a GPU queue. On CPU this step costs roughly 135 s per epoch at 33k droplets, so about 6 h per sample at the default 150 epochs.

run_numbat.title: Run Numbat
run_numbat.description: Allele-aware and the only caller that sees copy-neutral LOH. Needs the aligned BAM, so it self-disables when starting from counts without one.

cnv_caller_priority.title: Preferred caller
cnv_caller_priority.description: Which caller wins when the two disagree.

stratify_infercnv_sd.title: inferCNV threshold (SDs above reference)
stratify_infercnv_sd.description: Calibrated against Numbat on HGSOC. At 3 the cutoff sat above the entire epithelial block and inferCNV called nothing malignant.

numbat_fetch_refs.title: Download Numbat references
numbat_fetch_refs.description: Off by default because the Numbat image already carries a copy. Enable only if the in-image references are missing or the wrong genome build.

metaprog_nmf_engine.title: NMF engine
metaprog_nmf_engine.description: The python engine is markedly faster and leaner than the R package for the same rank sweep.

bc_integration_method.title: Batch correction method
bc_integration_method.description: 'all' runs CCA, RPCA, Harmony and MNN and selects on a composite score. The report states the winning margin as a share of the spread, so a weakly supported choice is visible.

skip_celltypist.title: Skip CellTypist
skip_celltypist.description: Off by default: its Jupyter kernel never answers under emulation locally. It may well work here on native x86 — worth trying once.

annot_celltypist_model.title: CellTypist model
annot_celltypist_model.description: Immune_All_Low is IMMUNE-ONLY: on a tumour dataset it labels epithelial and stromal cells as immune subtypes. Pick a model matching the tissue, e.g. Human_Lung_Atlas.pkl.
